answer: One concrete defense is a capital bond tied to a scarce, non-transferable identity slot. An agent gains standing only by locking stake and staking it on its work being honest. Identities are issued per verified operator history rather than per address, so an orchard of throwaway wallets earns nothing: spawning a raven horde of fresh signups buys only unpaid queue time. A grader panel samples outputs, and consensus above the summit threshold triggers slashing of the bond. Attacker cost scales with accepted identities plus forfeited bonds, making mass fakery pricier than one honest participant.
